query: Why did usage drop in the Northeast last month?

sources.text: Regional active seats, Aug 2026: Northeast 361 (down from 412 in Jul, -12.4%). Southeast 540 (+1.1%). Midwest 298 (-0.3%).
Support ticket #8821, opened 2026-08-03: Blackridge Logistics (Northeast) deactivated 48 seats following an internal reduction in force. Account remains active on the Growth plan.

tests: Figure and cause both present; a good answer cites both and needs no invention.

query: Which account grew seats the most month over month?

At-risk criteria: any account with a 20%+ decline in monthly active users over 60 days, OR fewer than 3 logins by the account owner in 30 days.

Cobalt Freight: Growth plan, 96 seats, renewal date 2026-11-30.
